posts.title: What do we do with logging in libraries?
posts.description: What do we do with logging in libraries? Logging has been a major headache for library authors for a long time. Library code is dropped into highly opinionated application environments, and whatever choices you make as a maintainer, you simply cannot satisfy everybody. You use info logs? More like debug. posts.description: Teaching LLMs new UI tricks Chat interfaces are by far the most popular way of interacting with LLMs today. posts.description: Concurrent Reads, Serialized Writes with GenServer and Registry Of all the OTP abstractions, GenServer is the most iconic one.
